data.name: HowToPlay_Subtitle
data.value: The rules of Yacht Dice in one minute.

data.name: HowToPlay_GoalText
data.value: You play one round for each category of your scorecard, scoring points with five dice. When every category is filled, the player with the most points wins.

data.name: HowToPlay_Step2
data.value: Choose the dice you want to keep and roll the rest again. You can roll up to three times in total.

data.name: HowToPlay_Step3
data.value: When you are ready, pick a free category on your scorecard and score the points. If the dice do not make the combination, you score 0. Each category can be used only once.

data.name: HowToPlay_UpperRuleText
data.value: You add up only the dice that show the number of the category. With 3, 3, 3, 5 and 6 in Threes you score 9, because only the three 3s count.

data.name: HowToPlay_BonusText
data.value: If your Ones to Sixes add up to 63 points or more (for example, three dice of each number), you get 35 extra points.

data.name: HowToPlay_FourOfAKindText
data.value: At least four dice that are the same. You score the sum of only four of them. Example: 5+5+5+5 = 20 points; the fifth die does not count.

data.name: HowToPlay_FullHouseText
data.value: Three dice that are the same plus two other dice that are the same as each other. You score the sum of all five dice. Example: 2+2+3+3+3 = 13 points.

data.name: HowToPlay_YachtText
data.value: All five dice the same. You score 50 points.

data.name: HowToPlay_WinText
data.value: At the end, all your categories and the bonus are added up. The player with the most points wins, and the points of each game count for the ranking.

data.name: HowToPlay_TipsText
data.value: Keep the dice that repeat the most. If a category is no longer reachable, give it up by scoring 0 in the one that hurts you least.

data.value: Works with any combination. You score the sum of all five dice. Example: 1+3+4+5+6 = 19 points.

data.name: HowToPlay_YachtBonusText
data.value: If you already scored 50 points in Yacht and you roll another Yacht, you get 100 extra points. If you scored 0 in Yacht, there is no bonus.

data.name: HowToPlay_JokerText
